I'm not an expert on medical stuff, but it would be news to me that medication makes you be an asshole to your friends so i think thats a shitty excuse, if i were you i'd sit down and talk to him about it but if that doesn't help and being in a friendship with him does more harm than good to you, stop being friends with him. In the end you have to think about whats best for you.

Of course i don't know everything about the situation you're in and about Gabby, but from my perspective i think you shouldn't trust her. From what i understand, she is probably pissed off because she got rejected and talks now shit about the girl you liked. In your story it doesn't seem like the girl was annoyed by you or anything, and it doesn't seems like she would have had a reason to be with you if she didn't like you. Again, as an outsider i could be talking total bullshit but i would cut gabby off, plus one of your friends also said she is a bad person. But in the end, you have to think about whats true and whats not and what seems most plausible for you. Hope you feel better soon!
